t: Sandtex 10Ltr Fine Textured Masonry Paint in Cornish Cream provides a durable and protective finish for exterior walls. This high-quality outdoor paint is perfect for refurbishing residential or commercial façades, ensuring long-lasting performance. Featuring Microseal Technology, the formulation creates a breathable, dirt-resistant and waterproof barrier, covering fine cracks effectively. This large 10Ltr tub offers excellent coverage, applying smoothly with a brush and roller onto concrete, pebble-dash, render and stone. It is touch-dry and recoatable in 3-4 hours, enabling quick completion of painting projects.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
